puzzles.title: Back-rank rook mate
puzzles.hint: The black king is trapped on the back rank.
puzzles.explanation: Rook to e8 is checkmate because the pawns on f7, g7, and h7 block the king.

puzzles.title: Back-rank queen mate
puzzles.hint: Use the open file to the eighth rank.
puzzles.explanation: Queen to a8 (or d8) mates on the back rank.

puzzles.title: Supported queen mate
puzzles.hint: Place the queen next to the king.
puzzles.explanation: Queen to g7 or h7 is mate with the king supporting.

puzzles.title: Knight smothered mate net
puzzles.hint: The knight can check from a square the king cannot escape.
puzzles.explanation: Knight to f7 is checkmate because the king is boxed in by its own rook and pawns.

puzzles.title: Queen diagonal mate
puzzles.hint: Check along the long diagonal into the corner.
puzzles.explanation: Queen to e8 mates.

puzzles.title: Rook file mate against cornered king
puzzles.hint: The back rank is open.
puzzles.explanation: Rook to b8 is checkmate.

puzzles.title: Ladder mate start
puzzles.hint: Check on the seventh rank, then mate on the eighth.
puzzles.explanation: The rooks alternate checks on consecutive ranks to force mate.

puzzles.title: Back-rank lure
puzzles.hint: Force the king onto a square where the next check mates.
puzzles.explanation: A queen check forces a reply that allows mate on the following move.

puzzles.title: Rook check then mate
puzzles.hint: Keep the king confined, then deliver the final check.
puzzles.explanation: After a checking retreat or lift, the rook mates on the edge.

puzzles.title: Queen check forces mate
puzzles.hint: Check so that the king must step into a mating net.
puzzles.explanation: The queen checks and the follow-up mates with king support.

puzzles.title: Corner mate with rook and king
puzzles.hint: Cut the escape file, then mate on the edge.
puzzles.explanation: The rook and king force the black king into the corner for mate.

puzzles.title: Ladder mate in three
puzzles.hint: Advance the rook ladder one rank at a time.
puzzles.explanation: Three alternating rook checks drive the king to the edge and mate.

puzzles.title: Back-rank double rook
puzzles.hint: The a-file is open to the first rank.
puzzles.explanation: Rook to a1 mates because white has no flight square.

puzzles.title: Knight forks king and queen
puzzles.hint: Find the square that checks and attacks the queen.
puzzles.explanation: Knight to c6 or f7 or g6 forks king and queen when the geometry fits; search validates.

puzzles.title: Pawn fork of two pieces
puzzles.hint: Advance the pawn to attack both knights.
puzzles.explanation: Pawn to d6 forks the knights on c6 and e6.

puzzles.title: Skewer-like pin on file
puzzles.hint: The queen cannot leave the file without exposing the king.
puzzles.explanation: The rook already faces the queen and king; capturing or maintaining the pin wins material.

puzzles.title: Bishop skewer on the diagonal
puzzles.hint: Check through the king toward the queen.
puzzles.explanation: Bishop to c4 or similar checks and skewers the queen beyond the king.

puzzles.title: Queen skewer
puzzles.hint: Check on the file or rank with the enemy rook behind the king.
puzzles.explanation: Queen check skewers the rook behind the king.

puzzles.title: Queen sacrifice for mate
puzzles.hint: A heavy sacrifice opens the king shelter for mate.
puzzles.explanation: Sacrificing the queen on g7 or h7 (when supported) forces mate next — verified by search for forced mate lines.

puzzles.title: Deflect the back-rank defender
puzzles.hint: Force the defending rook off the back rank.
puzzles.explanation: Exchanging or checking so the defender leaves allows back-rank mate.

puzzles.title: Deflection of the queen defender
puzzles.hint: Lure the queen away from a key square.
puzzles.explanation: A forcing move deflects the queen and wins material or mates.

puzzles.title: Promote with checkmate
puzzles.hint: Promote to a queen that immediately mates or forces mate.
puzzles.explanation: Pawn to e8 promoting to queen wins; if mate exists on the promotion square it is preferred.

puzzles.title: Underpromotion motif
puzzles.hint: A knight promotion may be stronger than a queen.
puzzles.explanation: Promoting to a knight delivers a fork or mate that queen promotion would miss.

puzzles.title: Queening wins the race
puzzles.hint: Promote before the enemy king can stop the pawn.
puzzles.explanation: Pawn to g8 equals a new queen and a winning endgame.

puzzles.title: Promotion with capture
puzzles.hint: Capture on the promotion square if needed.
puzzles.explanation: Taking the knight with promotion creates a decisive queen.

puzzles.title: Mate in one
puzzles.hint: Find a move that leaves the opposing king with no escape.
puzzles.explanation: The solution delivers checkmate in a single move.

puzzles.title: Mate in two
puzzles.hint: Force a position where mate cannot be avoided next move.
puzzles.explanation: After the forcing move, every defense allows mate on the following turn.
